title: Apache ZooKeeper image release lines 3.7 and older are end-of-life
summary: These Apache ZooKeeper release lines no longer receive fixes from the vendor.
replacement: A zookeeper image on a supported release line

constraints: Keep the base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use zookeeper on one supported ZooKeeper release line.
Confirm the application and its data or configuration work on the target ZooKeeper release; read the vendor's upgrade notes before moving across several release lines.

steps.title: Update the base image
steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.

steps.title: Align other image references
steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container starts on the new base.
